evidence.observation: Temperature followed the ramp setpoint within about 1 °C. It overshot to 760.4 °C when growth started, then settled at 750 ± 1 °C.
Heater power rose smoothly during the ramp and held steady at about 45% during growth, which is consistent with holding temperature.
Argon flow stayed within about 1 sccm of setpoint (200 sccm in purge, 100 sccm in ramp and growth).

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge or O2 exhaust sensor is installed, so a seal leak or exhaust blockage can't be detected. No reference values were provided, so I can't compare against normal runs. The sample has not been characterized yet.
